title: Why DOPSR let Grusch talk about downed craft and dead pilots

tellings.quote: this is why it's confusing and why Dave can say we have multiple downcraft and have collected dead pilots

plain: In 2023, the Defense Office of Prepublication and Security Review (DOPSR), the Pentagon office that decides what former officials may say in public, cleared David Grusch to state that the US has several downed craft and has recovered dead pilots. Grusch is a former intelligence officer who went public with these claims. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped retrieve a UFO, offers Michels his own theory of why the office allowed it. He admits it is confusing and does not spell out how the clearance worked.
